messages:
ella_sales: FYI Eversafe POC is ready to sign an order form but procurement insists on a PO + net45. They also returned a DPA redline and want SLA bumped to 99.95. Can legal/ops advise path of least friction?

maria_ps: Do we need to accept net45 for POC? It's small ARR but they insist on PO. Who's the signer on their side? @tom_procure any tip on routing?

tom_procure: Their procurement lead is 'Alex R.'. They require PO on invoice and net45 is standard for them. They'll only sign via DocuSign. PO ok from our side if legal signs off on the DPA/SLA changes.

jim_legal: I grabbed their redline — uploading to drive now: https://drive.redwood.internal/eversafe/dpa-redline (perm: legal team). Quick read: they shortened data deletion to 7 days, want open-ended subprocessor rights, and request SLA 99.95 with a 10% credit cap.

ella_sales: Revenue ops says POC revenue is ~45k ARR if it converts. Sales is asking for a 3-business-day turn on legal, otherwise we lose momentum. Can we timebox?

jim_legal: We should not accept 7-day deletion for production. For a scoped POC we can offer a limited exception: 14-day deletion and a POC-specific amendment that expires after 60 days. SLA: we can offer 99.95 for the POC only, but with a credit cap of 3% and explicit term limit. Liability and subprocessor language must stay close to our standard.

jim_legal: Example amendment snippet I'm proposing (will post redline shortly):
```
SLA (POC Amendment): For the POC term, Redwood will target 99.95% monthly uptime. Credit remedy limited to service credits not exceeding 3% of monthly fees for the POC term. All other warranty and liability provisions remain as set forth in the Agreement.
Data Deletion (POC): At the conclusion of the POC term, Redwood will securely delete Customer Data within 14 days unless Customer provides written instruction to extend retention.
```

contract-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared by ella_sales — envelope id: env_0a9f — status: draft. Link: https://docusign.redwood/env/env_0a9f

maria_ps: Order form needs to include: 2 dedicated seats, model access tier = dedicated-lite, POC term 60 days, billing contact billing@eversafe.com and PO number field. Can sales add that to the OF?

ella_sales: I'll update the OF and attach Jim's POC amendment once he posts final redline. Routing plan: 1) send DocuSign to Alex (procurement) with PO field, 2) once signed, countersign via DocuSign, 3) Ops to issue invoice net45. @tom_procure confirm billing email?

tom_procure: Confirm billing email: billing@eversafe.com. Procurement approves PO referencing invoice. Net45 ok.

jim_legal: Posted final redline in drive and applied the POC amendment to the order form. Link: https://drive.redwood.internal/eversafe/final-poc-amendment.docx

contract-bot: DocuSign envelope env_0a9f sent to Alex R. and billing@eversafe.com. Status: sent.

ella_sales: Great — sending now. Timebox reminder: please review/sign by EOD tomorrow if possible. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

contract-bot: Envelope env_0a9f signed by Alex R. at 2026-03-20T14:12:30Z. Waiting for Redwood countersignature.

ella_sales: Countersigned and uploaded to SFDC. Invoice request queued to finance with PO number included. Moving to billing ops. :party-parrot:

maria_ps: Marking POC provisioning ready once payment team confirms PO receipt. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
